Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses UGC DAE CSR seeks offers from only those Chartered Accountants, who have 1 Acquainted with General Financial Rules of Govt. Of India, Orders thereunder which Consortium follows.

2 Empaneled with CAG, for auditing of the financial accounts. 3 Three years experience of statutory audit of Uniform Format of Accounts for the Central Autonomous Bodies under Ministry of Education after 2013-14, The experience should be of the partner handling/managing Indore office. 4 Head office/Registered office/Branch office of the same firm's name (bidder) in Indore (ICI certificate sho uld be attached). 5 MSME preferable. 6 Number of Years of firm/company’s existence as per ICAI certificate- 10 Years 7 Number of full-time partners/experienced and qualified professionals in full time employment at senior level with experience in handling similar or relevant projects- 3 Partners. 8 Number of partners/ qualified professionals in full time employment with DISA/CISA qualification- 1 No. 9 Number of XX fulltime CA’s required and YY professional audit staff- 3 full time CA and 6 professional staff. 10 The bid must contain detailed profile and list of names & addresses of the Central Central Autonomous institutions of which audit has been/is being done. Scope of work The auditor should 1. Perform the audit of the financial accounts of Indore, Mumbai and Kolkata at the respective Centres. The consortium will provide local hospitality and travel expenses to the auditors as per TA rules of Government of India, for audit at Mumbai and Kolkata Centres. 2. Perform the audit of Head office of UGC DAE CSR at Indore. 3. Consolidate the audited financial accounts of head office and all the three centers, at UGC DAE CSR Indore 4. Issue separate Letter to management, as a report of audit for all the three Centres. 5. Final Audit report, for UGC DAE CSR, Indore. 6. Certificate of Utilization of Grants for UGC DAE CSR, Indore. Special Condition: Audit fees for the work should not be less than Rs.90,000/ plus GST per year. .
